audit_scope: Worker-4/worker-6 source-reviewed audit of linked DBAASP/DRAMP assay, experiment, activity, and literature rows against primary XML/PDF results, OA figures, packet database snapshots, and merged sequence/experiment catalogs.

primary_source_evidence.peptide_identity: Section 2.1 identifies LL-37, temporin-SHa, [K3]SHa, and temporin-Tb; Introduction states SHa is 13 residues and C-terminally amidated and [K3]SHa is Ser3Lys.
primary_source_evidence.cytotoxicity: Section 3.1/Figure 1 source-verifies LL-37 80% viability at 5 µM, SHa 77% at 20 µM, and [K3]SHa 74% at 10 µM.
primary_source_evidence.antiviral_replication: Section 3.2/Figure 2 source-verifies LL-37 94% reduction at 2.5 µM, SHa 52% at 10 µM, [K3]SHa 48% at 2.5 µM and 57% at 5 µM.
primary_source_evidence.virucidal_assay: Section 3.4/Figure 4 source-verifies SHa 99.4% infectious-titer reduction after 10 µM pre-incubation.
primary_source_evidence.database_sequence_context: Merged sequence catalogs provide exact sequences for linked records; exact sequence strings are not all embedded in this article, so affected assay/activity rows remain source_conflict with context.
